observability._note: AppHost manifest (ADR-040). The observability block reproduces the output of the now-deleted hand-written HealthController + MetricsController; /api/health and /api/metrics are aliased to AppHost\Controller\GenericHealth#index / GenericMetrics#index in appinfo/routes.php. The deepLinks block replaces the hand-written DeepLinkRegistrationListener, read at event time by the generic listener. Parity: the database health check and implicit planix_info/planix_up metrics match the pre-adoption contract; the task/project object counts are a documented intentional improvement (object-count observability the bespoke MetricsController never emitted). This is an observability-only manifest (schema v2.13.0 profile): planix renders no manifest-driven UI, so there is deliberately no menu/pages — the former top-level appId/name keys were removed 2026-07-06 (not part of the v2 contract; the app id comes from the runtime).
